en_fr_word_translation.description: Translate a common English noun/adjective into French in a few-shot list format. Control: same few-shot format but the line asks to repeat the English word (copy).

two_digit_addition.description: Add two 2-digit numbers (few-shot 'a + b = c'). Control: same format, answer is copying the first operand ('first of a and b is a').

python_list_index.description: Trace Python list indexing (including negative indices): predict the printed value of xs[i]. Control: same code, asks for the literal first element written in the list (no index semantics).

recall_first_number.description: Recall the first element written in a Python list of numbers, prompted by a comment ('# first element written:'). Control: identical format but the list holds English words, so recall is of a word rather than a number.

month_successor.description: Name the month that comes N (1-3) months after a given month, few-shot. Control: same format but asks to repeat the given month (copy), so no calendar arithmetic is needed.

object_color.description: Name the typical colour of a common object (banana -> yellow). Control: same format, but the colour is given in the line and must be repeated, so no world knowledge of colour is needed.

two_digit_subtraction.description: Subtract two 2-digit numbers (a >= b), few-shot 'a - b = c'. Control: same format, answer copies the second operand ('second of a and b is b').

times_table.description: Single-digit by 1-2 digit multiplication (a in 2..9, b in 2..19), few-shot 'a x b = c'. Control: same format, answer copies the larger operand ('larger of a and b is ...').
